This Miscellaneous First Appeal is filed under Section 173(1) of M.V. Act pleased to call for the records and allow the above appeal by setting aside the impugned judgment and award dated 17.04.2017 in MVC NO.1882/2013 passed by the MACT, Vijayapura, in the interest of justice and equity.
These appeals coming on for Conciliation before Lok Adalat, this day, the following order is passed:
CONCILIATION ORDER
The learned counsel for the Appellant/Claimant and the representative of Respondent-Insurance Company along with its counsel are present.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.

The Appellant/Claimant has agreed to receive and the Respondent-Insurance Company has agreed to pay a lump-sum compensation of Rs.1,25,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Twenty Five Thousand only), in full and final settlement including Lower Court award amount.
The appellant has to deposit remaining amount after deducting already deposited amount.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.

opennyai_summary.decision:
This Miscellaneous First Appeal is filed under Section 173(1) of M.V. Act pleased to call for the records and allow the above appeal by setting aside the impugned judgment and award dated 17.04.2017 in MVC NO.1882/2013 passed by the MACT, Vijayapura, in the interest of justice and equity.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.
The Appellant/Claimant has agreed to receive and the Respondent-Insurance Company has agreed to pay a lump-sum compensation of Rs.1,25,000/- (Rupees One Lakh Twenty Five Thousand only), in full and final settlement including Lower Court award amount.
The appellant has to deposit remaining amount after deducting already deposited amount.
A joint Memo is filed on behalf of the parties to this effect.
Same is accepted.
The entire amount shall be released in favour of the Claimant.
4. The Respondent-Insurance Company has agreed to deposit the said amount before the Tribunal within six weeks from the date of preparation of Award, failing which the said amount shall carry interest at the rate of 9% p.a. from the date of default, till the date of deposit.
5. The Miscellaneous First Appeal No.201918/2017 stands disposed of in terms of the Joint Memo.
The award of the Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.
In view of the settlement between the parties, MFA No.201064/2017 stands disposed off.
Draw up the award accordingly.
